dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I love this place! It feels like we've just walked straight into a fairytale, where we're both dazzling warriors!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But that seems to be as far as the magic goes... No invincibility or anything. It still hurts when I get hit, and I still get tired after fighting for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That means we can't just defeat all the enemies in one fell swoop. We'll have to pace ourselves and keep replenishing our energy. I brought plenty of Blazed Meat Stew — you want some?
